body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 7a1163bfb6ff91acabab0bf48c17eddbc09981b6 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes toolpaths and posted G-code. I checked this head with current upstream/main in a separate local worktree. The trial merge had no conflicts. I used no GitHub runner.

What passed:

- The selected motion tests: 539 passed, 6 ignored. These include the library tests and blind_floor, circular_arcs, level_links, machining2d, machining3d, predrilled_entry, top_z_level, turning_face, and vertical_arc_entry.
- The post tests: 48 passed across post_engine, recorded_streams, and vertical_arc_entry.
- The app checks for blind floors, CL goldens, solid-law goldens, stock above Top Z, and verification passed.
- The line-by-line audit of 139 changed CL/NC files found no safety defect. These golden changes come from parent #2013. The #2088 commit changes no goldens.
- I repeated both mutations. With entry.rs and rest.rs restored to a290caad, 4 of 5 blind_floor tests failed. With the early return for a non-empty first level, the test for a shallow hole beside a deeper cut failed with `blind hole must be cut: []`. After each restoration, all 5 tests passed. No mutation remains.

Requested before merge:

1. **Fix the test build after the trial merge.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs:91` adds the required `material_top` field. The upstream fixture at `crates/motion/tests/trochoid_slot.rs:331` does not set it. Update that initializer and check all targets again. Clippy for motion, app, and post stopped with:

   ```text
   error[E0063]: missing field `material_top` in initializer of `camcraft_motion::machining2d::TrochoidParams`
      --> crates/motion/tests/trochoid_slot.rs:331:13
   ```

2. **Make the affected app tests pass with the new level law.** For example, `crates/app/tests/operations.rs:2244` still expects three plunges at `[5, 2.5, 0]`, but the path has two. `crates/app/tests/wall_arc_entry.rs:357` still expects four arc entries, including Top Z 20, but the path has three. The selected app tests finished with **281 passed, 18 failed, 8 ignored**. These are the parent-related failures recorded in the PR body. They remain on this head after the trial merge. Include the remaining parent test fixes and run these suites again. Keep the safety assertions.

   | Failed app suite | Passed | Failed |
   |---|---:|---:|
   | operations | 117 | 3 |
   | predrilled_entry | 6 | 2 |
   | project_roundtrip | 72 | 1 |
   | remachining | 4 | 2 |
   | stitch_cross | 4 | 2 |
   | turning_face_approach | 2 | 1 |
   | turning_face_seed | 4 | 1 |
   | wall_arc_entry | 1 | 6 |

   Example failure:

   ```text
   crates/app/tests/operations.rs:2244:5
   assertion `left == right` failed
     left: 2
    right: 3
   ```

The PR changes no crates/ui files. Screenshots are not required. Heavy ignored tests and the release gate did not run. The PR remains a draft with needs-rework.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
